name: 24664-eagle3longctx-gptoss20b-1gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-20b as the target, with Dogacel/specdrift-gpt-oss-20b-eagle3 as the EAGLE-3 draft head. DO NOT SUBSTITUTE THE DRAFT HEAD: it is the only public gpt-oss-20b EAGLE-3 checkpoint whose declared architecture is LlamaForCausalLMEagle3, and the other public ones load through different classes.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1: 14.6 GB of weights fit one card and the rest of the 80 GB is KV.
architecture: Target GptOssForCausalLM: 24 layers, hidden 2880, MoE with 32 experts and 4 active, mxfp4 weights (~12.8 GB), context 131072. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle3: one decoder layer, hidden 2880, bf16 (~1.8 GB resident).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 128 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure, seed 42. Prompts a FIXED 32768 tokens; generations a FIXED 2048 tokens, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.7` rather than greedy sampling.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant with draft-model acceleration, serving 16 concurrent 32k-token requests on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving gpt-oss-20b with an EAGLE-3 draft head, every request carrying a 32K-token
# context in front of a 2048-token generation.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented/nested block is SKIPPED when this file is read, and the
# engine would then start without something declared here. Keep structured values on one line.

model-path: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tp-size: 1

# 5 steps x topk 1 -> 6 verified positions is a CHAIN, not a tree. All four values move together.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: Dogacel/specdrift-gpt-oss-20b-eagle3
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6

# Explicit, and equal to what this architecture resolves to on sm90 anyway.
attention-backend: fa3

# 32768 prompt + 2048 generation + the 6-position chain in flight, rather than the checkpoint's
# 131072, so the token-to-request pool is sized for the workload.
context-length: 36864

random-seed: 42

# Everything else -- mem-fraction-static, page-size, chunked-prefill-size, cuda-graph-max-bs,
# max-running-requests and every cache and KV-pool setting -- is left at the engine's defaults.
